jobs.description: iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing. Fully remote and flexible. You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met. Task volume varies with project demand.

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Typeform is fully remote by design. customers.</li> <li>Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.</li> <li>Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.</li> <li>Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.</li> <li>Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, attribution.</li> <li>Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.</li> <li>Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.</li> <li>Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.</li> </ul> <h3>What we’re jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p>The position of the&nbsp;<strong>Senior Value Engineer</strong>&nbsp;is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.</p> <p><strong>Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.</strong></p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong><strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Identify &amp; Frame Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers&nbsp;</li> <li>Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive</li> </ul> <p><strong>Realize Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement</li> <li>Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives</li> <li>Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing</li> <li>Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligen

Lead or support investigations into non-conformances, deviations, material issues, and unexpected test results. Maintain clear traceability of materials, batches, samples, equipment, results, and technical decisions. Work with the Lead Propellant Manager and manufacturing teams to improve process capability, measurement quality, and production consistency. What we are looking for Experience in quality control, quality engineering, laboratory testing, or process control within a chemical, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment. Strong understanding of measurement systems, test methods, sampling, data review, and technical documentation. Experience investigating non-conformances, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions. A methodical and detail-oriented approach to safety, traceability, data integrity, and compliance. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams. jobs.description: About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor. Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications. Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components. Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Qualification and educational requirements Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred. Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry. Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next. High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals. High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product. High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype. Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works. Your mission Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer. What you will do Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope. Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data. Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps. Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start. Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers. Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use. Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years. Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop. How you work You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work. You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises. You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early. You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects. You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product. Who you work with Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership.  What you bring Must have Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day Stakeholder

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Empower every employee. Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen. Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenausschreibung KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen. Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen. Was dich erwartet KI-Architektur verantworten : Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab. Die größte Herausforderung annehmen : Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Die Disziplin führen und weiterentwickeln : Übernimm die disziplinarische Führung für drei KI-Engineers und hilf ihnen dabei, sich zu Engineers zu entwickeln, die den technischen Maßstab selbst setzen. Hands-on bleiben : Rund 70 Prozent deiner Zeit verbringst du im Code, an den Problemen, bei denen dein Urteilsvermögen am meisten zählt. Der Rest entfällt auf technische und disziplinarische Führung. Produktübergreifend Einfluss nehmen : Setze Architekturentscheidungen mit den Product Managern und Engineering Leads um, die die Roadmaps verantworten, die nicht in deinem Bereich liegen, und überzeuge dabei durch das bessere Argument statt durch Weisung. Mit unserem Stack arbeiten : Python, pydantic-ai für Orchestrierung, Qdrant für Vektorsuche, Azure AI für Modelle, deployed auf Kubernetes in ein überwiegend JVM-basiertes (Kotlin, Micronaut) und Go-Backend. Eine junge Disziplin mitgestalten : KI-Engineering ist bei Flip so neu, dass es enormen Gestaltungsspielraum gibt und noch kein festes Playbook existiert. Was du mitbringst Wir suchen einen Engineer mit einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament und echter Praxiserfahrung mit agentenbasierten Systemen in Produktion, der eine Disziplin führen möchte, statt nur an einer Codebase zu arbeiten. Wenn dich die Rolle reizt, du aber nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Must-haves: 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz auf Senior- oder Staff-Level, aufbauend auf einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament (Backend, Platform oder Full-Stack). Praxiserfahrung im Design, Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver LLM-basierter Systeme: RAG, Tool Calling und MCP, Orchestrierung und Evals. Keine Prototypen, sondern Systeme, mit denen du auch nach dem Go-live gelebt hast. Erfahrung mit Multi-Agenten-Orchestrierung, die besonders stark gewichtet wird. Das ist der Kern dessen, was du architektonisch verantworten würdest. Nachgewiesene technische Führungserfahrung: Architekturverantwortung, Tech-Lead-Verantwortung, RFCs, Design Reviews oder das Setzen von Standards für ein Team. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit voranzubringen, die nicht in deinem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich liegt: Du gewinnst Architekturdiskussionen durch Überzeugungskraft und Glaubwürdigkeit und bist es gewohnt, recht zu haben, ohne die Entscheidungsgewalt zu haben. Nachweise dafür, dass du Menschen weiterentwickelst: Coaching oder Mentoring von Engineers hin zu stärkeren Engineers, statt ihnen die Arbeit abzunehmen

jobs.description: Type: Full-time Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site The Role Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models. jobs.title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role The Applied AI team own Callosum's customer engagements end to end. You will work directly with customer engineering teams to understand their AI workloads, design and run rigorous evaluations against their production pipelines, integrate optimised workflows into their systems, and make sure the results hold in production. At Callosum, Applied AI Engineers are the technical bridge between what customers run and what we build. What you learn shapes the research and platform roadmap. The evaluations you run are how we prove the technology in production. As an early member of the team, you will help build the methodology, tooling, and engagement practices the function runs on. The role is engineering-led: you will employ technical judgment to recognise what kind of system a problem needs and prototype it. You will work closely with the engineers designing new intelligent systems, with the platform team that serves them, and directly with senior technical stakeholders on the customer side. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI function as the team scales. What You'll Build Customer engagement from first workload scoping through evaluation, integration, and production deployment Design and run rigorous evaluations on customers' production workloads: set success criteria, instrument the comparison, present results to their engineering teams Develop deep technical understanding of customer systems (retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, code intelligence stacks) and design optimised Callosum workflows Integrate Callosum workflow

About the role As part of IG Group, Freetrade combines the pace of a scale-up with the backing of a global leader in trading. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, which was built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!  Cirrus Logic is looking for talented Summer and MEng Engineering Interns to join their experienced engineering teams in Edinburgh, Newbury and London, and work on industrial projects relevant to their degree. This exciting opportunity includes openings in the following areas: Embedded Firmware   Software Tools   Software Drivers   System Test   Summer placements are running between June and September. MEng placements running between April and January. Departmental Summary: Embedded Firmware - You should be comfortable writing code in C/C++ and familiar with interpreted languages such as Python. With a strong background in signal processing, mathematical modelling, or algorithm design, you will collaborate with hardware designers to develop, debug, and optimize firmware, enabling the integration of innovative solutions onto commercial product platforms. Software Tools - You will work alongside experienced software, hardware and UX engineers to create cross-platform desktop tools and developer workflows using technologies such as Java and Python. Your work could contribute to interactive configuration and tuning tools, automation, plugins or APIs used by engineering teams across the company. Experience with Java, Python, C++, C# or desktop application development is helpful, but not a must. Software Drivers - You should be comfortable writing code in C and familiar with Linux kernel development, debugging tools, and automated test frameworks. With a strong background in computer science, electrical, electronic, or software engineering, and an interest in operating systems and embedded hardware, you will develop, debug, and optimize Linux (and MCU) device drivers, build and run automated tests through CI systems such as Jenkins, and work closely with cross-functional teams to enable reliable integration of commercial and consumer product platforms. System Test - You should be comfortable writing code in Python and familiar with object-oriented languages like C++. With a background in electrical, electronic, computer, or software engineering and an interest in embedded systems and hardware/software integration, you will develop and run automated functional, system, and stress tests on real hardware, from FPGA emulation through to silicon. Skills and Requirements: Enrolled in MEng or BEng in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Engineering or a related subject degree and on track for a 2:1 or better Some experience with development/evaluation of signal processing Good understanding of software development principles Interest in Embedded Systems Excellent problem-solving ability Excellent written and verbal communication skills What to expect from your internship with Cirrus Logic: Working on a detailed technical project relevant to your degree Mentoring, coaching and development by top engineers Interaction with other students and future leaders Learning about our values and goals and experiencing a culture that fosters innovation, creativity, and timely execution Develop your teamwork, planning, creative thinking, and problem-solving skills A modern, state-of-the-art office environment in Edinburgh or Newbury Competitive salary, great benefits, discounted lunches, on-site gymnasium, games area, jam room, happy hours, social events and free snacks, drinks &a

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst – Labour & Productivity
jobs.description: <p><strong>The Role..</strong></p> <p>We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&amp;A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.</p> <p>We are currently selecting an advanced scheduling platform to support this. The analytical foundation underneath it,how we measure productivity, what our labour standards are, how good our demand forecasts need to be - is what this role owns.</p> <p>You will sit in the Data team and work in close partnership with FP&amp;A. Analysis alone will not move the number; changes stick when a Finance Business Partner and a General Manager can see the opportunity in their own House, agree the size of it and hold it in their forecast. Your job is to give them that, in a form they can act on.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities..</strong></p> <ul> <li>Labour productivity analysis, identifying site-by-site opportunities for efficiency gains and sizing each one</li> <li>Work with Operations and Finance to trial changes to scheduling and measure their impact</li> <li>Build improved labour reporting, so Business Partners and GMs can see productivity, schedule changes and shift adherence on a daily and weekly cadence</li> <li>Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role</li> <li>Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements</li> <li>Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What we are looking for..</span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result</li> <li>A track record of partnering finance and operational stakeholders to land change, not just report on it</li> <li>Several years in an analytics role, with genuine multi-site operational exposure — hospitality, retail, leisure or QSR</li> <li>Advanced SQL, and comfort in a modelled data warehouse (experience with dbt an advantage)</li> <li>BI development experience (Omni, Looker, Tableau or Power BI), building tools operators actually use</li> <li>Experience with rota, time and attendance and payroll data, and a realistic view of its challenges</li> <li>Able to evaluate a demand forecast critically — accuracy, bias, seasonality — without needing to build one</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Desirable..</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience with a workforce management or scheduling platform — Unifocus, HotSchedules, Dayforce, Fourth, S4 Labour, UKG, Quinyx or similar</li> <li>Strong financial modelling and fluency in P&amp;L mechanics — wage percentage, flow-through, contribution</li> <li>An understanding of how labour regulation constrains labour models internationally, particularly the US — predictive scheduling and fair workweek rules, overtime and break requirements</li> <li>Labour standards or time-and-motion experience</li> <li>Python for data analysis and modelling, and/or use of AI tooling such as Claude Code to accelerate it</li> <li>Experience linking labour deployment to custome

Beverage, Operations, Digital and Events.</p> <p>As Lead Data Scientist, you'll be the go-to expert for turning our vast datasets into predictive and prescriptive products that change how we run our Houses and serve our members, from predicting member churn and personalising what members see, to forecasting demand so our Houses are staffed well.</p> <p>You'll take models from idea to production and keep them performing, always looking for new ways to create value for our members and the business.</p> <p>You'll also raise the bar on how the wider analytics team measures impact, so decisions across the business rest on sound evidence.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities..</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Machine learning products</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the design, build and continuous improvement of Soho House's ML portfolio, including member churn and segmentations, personalisation and recommendation engines (e.g. events), and demand forecasting for labour and operational planning</li> <li>Frame business problems with stakeholders, pick the right approach (which may not always be ML), and set clear success metrics tied to commercial outcomes</li> <li>Own the full model lifecycle: scoping, development, validation, deployment, monitoring, scheduled recalibration and retirement</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">ML Ops and production</span></p> <ul> <li>Set up ML Ops standards: version control, model registry, documentation and governance</li> <li>Work with Data Engineering to put models into production on our stack (GCP, Snowflake, Airflow), with reliable scoring pipelines and outputs that downstream tools and teams can use</li> <li>Build monitoring and observability for model accuracy in production (tracked jobs.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible

jobs.title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
jobs.description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique , nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité. Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie , vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements , tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance. Missions Principales : Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ; Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ; Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ; Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ; Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ; Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ; Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ; Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ; Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ; Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé. Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées. Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée. Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus. Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée. Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission. Permis B requis. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tou

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Clinical Project Manager to oversee and coordinate clinical activities in pharmaceutical environment. The role involves managing operational aspects of clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and acting as the primary interface between local stakeholders, investigators, vendors, and global teams. This position requires strong autonomy, rigor, and excellent communication skills , with the ability to navigate cross‑functional environments. Key Responsibilities : 1. Study Management Lead and coordinate clinical trial activities at the local level from start‑up to close‑out. Ensure local execution of global study plans in alignment with timelines and quality standards. Serve as the key point of contact for local investigational sites and regional stakeholders. 2. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight Ensure that clinical trial activities comply with local regulations, ICH‑GCP, and internal SOPs. Coordinate local submissions to competent authorities and ethics committees when required. Monitor adherence to regulatory timelines and manage any corrective actions. 3. Site & Vendor Coordination Support site selection, activation, monitoring, and close‑out in collaboration with CRAs and vendors. Manage relationships with local vendors (logistics, labs, CRO partners). Follow up on recruitment progress, performance, and site‑level metrics. 4. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Work closely with global study teams, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, and clinical operations. Participate in study meetings and provide updates on local activities, challenges, and achievements. Support risk mitigation plans and operational troubleshooting. 5. Data Quality & Operational Tracking Oversee data accuracy, query resolution, and compliance of documentation. Track KPIs, patient recruitment, timelines, and operational deliverables. Contribute to audit and inspection readiness. Requirements Experienced in Clinical Operations within pharma or CRO. Experience as Clinical Project Manager, Study Manager, or equivalent . Previous involvement in interventional trials (Phase II–IV preferred). Solid understanding of ICH‑GCP, regulatory environment, and local clinical research practices. Experience collaborating with investigators, CROs, and cross‑functional teammates. Strong organizational, operational, and communication skills. Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment. Fluency in French and English (written & spoken). Benefits Why join us? At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare. Here's what makes us unique: We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience. Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey. Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission. jobs.title: STAGE R&D - Modélisation quantitative du risque sur les marchés prédictifs
jobs.description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.   Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?   Techniquement, Winamax c’est : Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience Contexte L'offre de paris sportifs chez Winamax repose sur le traitement en temps réel de flux massifs de données et l'ajustement continu de probabilités. Pour garantir la cohérence entre les cotes et l'exposition financière de Winamax, l'analyse automatisée des mouvements de marché, du volume des mises et des activités atypiques est devenue un enjeu stratégique.   La question à laquelle doit répondre le stage :  Comment détecter algorithmiquement les incohérences de probabilités et les volumes atypiques en temps réel pour fournir un Indice de Confiance fiable, capable d'assister la prise de décision ? Objectifs du stage Modéliser la cohérence des cotes et un Indice de Confiance : Concevoir des modèles statistiques pour repérer les décalages de probabilités et évaluer en temps réel la fiabilité des activités à fort volume, en croisant la notoriété de l'événement et son historique Intégrer le module au cœur de l'outil trading existant : Développer une brique algorithmique performante qui s'interface directement avec l'application métier des traders, afin d'enrichir leurs outils Validation & mesure de performance (Backtesting) : Tester et calibrer les modèles sur des historiques massifs de données pour maximiser leur précision, minimiser les fausses alertes et mesurer l'impact réel de l'outil sur l'activité Les points d'attention Temps réel et faible latence : capacité à traiter des flux à haute fréquence (milliers d'actualisations et d'activités par seconde) sans ralentir la réactivité des outils Volume de données et  backtesting : manipulation de séries temporelles complexes et capacité à tester/ajuster les modèles sur des bases historiques de plusieurs millions de lignes Précision du ciblage (taux de faux positifs) : nécessité d'ajuster finement les seuils statistiques pour remonter des signaux réellement pertinents sans engorger l'outil d'alertes inutiles Stack technique Python, Node.js, Sql Modalités de stage Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage Rémunération : 30k Processus de recrutement Test technique Screening RH avec Camille Entretien avec le manager et le maître de stage POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?   En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !   Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique  Une semaine de travail en 4 jours Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…) Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…) Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €) Un restaurant d’entreprise Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About AQEMIA AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs.  At the core of our mission is  QEMI , our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.   What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing  never-before-seen molecules , without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.   Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently  in vivo optimization , targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.   For more information, visit  AQEMIA.com,  our  WTTJ Page , and our  LinkedIn .    About our Team AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.   This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.   About our Engineering Department The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.   Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.   Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience. The role As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners. A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it. As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them. Responsibilities Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow. Model canon

jobs.title: Développeur C# / .Net (F/H/NB)
jobs.description: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques.  Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos de la mission Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Développeur .Net/C# (F/H/NB). Tes missions au quotidien : Back-end  : Maîtrise avancée de C# / .NET 8+, architectures Microservices et APIs sécurisées Data & Messaging : Gestion de la donnée sous toutes ses formes avec SQL Server, MongoDB et architectures orientées événements via Kafka Cloud & Industrialisation : Déploiement sur environnements Cloud Public (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) Craftsmanship : Le Clean Code, le TDD et les revues de code sont tes standards de livraison, pas des options ▪️ Le profil idéal Formation & Parcours : Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur, Master) ou équivalent. Expérience : 5 ans minimum comme Développeur .NET (idéalement sur de forts volumes de données ), avec une maîtrise de : .NET Core 8 , Microservices, DDD, REST & Design First . Databases & Messaging : SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ. DevOps & Cloud : DevOps (CI/CD), Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana. Outillage : Git, JIRA. Soft Skills : Esprit d'équipe, autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'initiative et curiosité technique. ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. ▪️ Tes conditions de travail  Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. ▪️ Le processus de recrutement  Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, C# et .Net) avec trois Sfeirians. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cible

jobs.description: Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. Why this role You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next. High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals. High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product. High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype. Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works. Your mission Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer. What you will do Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope. Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data. Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps. Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start. Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers. Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use. Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years. Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop. How you work You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work. You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises. You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early. You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects. You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product. Who you work with Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership.  What you bring Must have Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day Stakeholder

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare
jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team. In this role, you will: Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

jobs.title: People Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Rolle Du liebst es, wenn Prozesse einfach laufen? Du willst Anfragen nicht nur abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, warum sie entstehen, und das Problem an der Wurzel packen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig. Bei Zenjob dreht sich alles um unsere Zennies. Wir wollen, dass sie gern zu uns kommen, hier ihre beste Arbeit machen und so viel Spaß dabei haben, dass sie gar nicht mehr weg wollen. Genau dafür gibt es uns: das People Ops Team. Und nein, wir sind kein klassisches HR-Team. Wir verwalten keine „Ressourcen“, wir kümmern uns um Menschen. Wir sind die erste Anlaufstelle für alle Zennies, vom ersten bis zum letzten Arbeitstag. Wir begleiten sie durch den gesamten Employee Lifecycle und sind Sparringspartner für unsere Führungskräfte, wenn es um Personal- und Arbeitsrecht geht. Langweiliger Admin-Job mit immer denselben Aufgaben? Fehlanzeige. Wir suchen jemanden, der neugierig ist, gern um die Ecke denkt und Lust hat, unsere Prozesse mit Daten, Automatisierung und KI smarter zu machen. Damit bei uns alles rundläuft und sich unsere People Experience jedes Jahr ein Stück besser anfühlt. Was dich erwartet Vom ersten bis zum letzten Tag: Onboarding, Offboarding und alles dazwischen liegt in deinen Händen. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Prozesse laufen, misst, ob sie wirklich funktionieren, und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt. Erste Anlaufstelle: Ob Frage zur Gehaltsabrechnung oder neuer Vertrag, die Anliegen unserer Zennies und Führungskräfte landen in unserem Ticketsystem bei dir. Du löst sie schnell, präzise und so, dass sich alle gut aufgehoben fühlen. Operations, aber richtig: Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Arbeitszeugnisse, saubere Daten in unserem HRIS, die Vorbereitung und Prüfung der Gehaltsabrechnung und unser Firmenwagen-Fuhrpark: Du hast den Laden im Griff. Sparringspartner:in: Führungskräfte kommen mit ihren Personal- und Arbeitsrechtsfragen zu dir. Du berätst sie und machst unser Wissen mit klaren Leitfäden für alle zugänglich. Tech & Automatisierung: HiBob, Freshservice, Leapsome, n8n und Google Workspace werden deine besten Freunde. Du findest smarte Wege, mit Technologie und KI Zeit zu sparen und Prozesse besser zu machen. Partner & Stakeholder: Du hältst den Draht zu Lohnabrechnungsdienstleistern, Finanzbehörden, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen und Ämtern und behältst auch bei externen Audits einen kühlen Kopf. Projekte mit Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit dem P&C-Team treibst du bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran, von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Ergebnis. Was du mitbringst Du hast Erfahrung in People Operations oder als HR-Generalist:in und weißt, wie man Prozesse reibungslos am Laufen hält, ohne dass der Mensch dabei auf der Strecke bleibt. Deutsches Arbeitsrecht, Steuerrecht und Lohnabrechnung sind für dich kein Buch mit sieben Siegeln: Du kennst dich richtig gut aus. Du hast schon Projekte mit Stakeholdern vorangetrieben und kannst zeigen, was sich dadurch verändert hat. Technik macht dich neugierig: Du verstehst, wie Workflows und Daten zusammenspielen, und willst noch mehr darüber lernen. Details entgehen dir nicht. Daten sind bei dir korrekt und vertrauliche Infos in sicheren Händen, auf deine Arbeit kann man sich verlassen. Wenn es hektisch wird, bleibst du entspannt und behältst den Überblick. Du fragst dich nicht „Wie fülle ich meinen Tag?“, sondern „Wie nutze ich meine Zeit am besten?“ Menschen vertrauen dir schnell, weil du echt, zugänglich und hilfsbereit bist. Du denkst gern quer, bringst gute Energie mit und hast Humor. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C2) und Englisch. Wir bieten 🏖️ Zeit zum Abschalten & Auftanken 28 Urlaubstage (steigen alle zwei Kalenderjahre um 1 auf max. 30 Tage) 20 Tage "Work from Abroad“ pro Jahr (auch außerhalb der EU) 1 bezahlter Sonderurlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Arbeit 5 Tage bezahlter Bildungsurlaub Möglichkeit für unbezahlten Urlaub 10 bezahlte Tage beim krankheitsbedingten Ausfall deines Kindes 🚀 Weiterentwicklung & Lernen 750

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production. jobs.title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance. EMC by Design Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts. You enjoy working directly with hardware, from assembly and functional checks to troubleshooting. You turn technical content into clear training materials and practical exercises, assess participants’ progress and document results. You support international customer engagements and ensure that every activity follows applicable safety requirements and local regulations. Creation of engaging instructional materials, including manuals, presentations, and practical exercises. Maintaining this training documentation in German and/or English. Coordinate training and demonstration activities with customer teams, site operators and relevant authorities to ensure safe and compliant execution. Guide pre-flight checks, flight planning, post-flight and post-processing procedures. Assess trainee performance during both theoretical and practical training sessions. Provide constructive feedback and guidance to enhance skills and proficiency. What you bring to the team: You have 3+ years of experience in UAS operations, flight testing or field engineering in defence, aerospace or RC. You hold valid drone pilot qualifications for A1/A2/A3 and STS 1 & STS 2 or are willing to obtain them quickly. You have hands-on FPV piloting experience and understand FPV UAV capabilities, limitations and flight characteristics. Experience with turbine-powered model aircraft is a plus. You understand C-UAS detection, identification, tracking and threat assessment, and can explain system capabilities and limitations in an operational context. Relevant C-UAS experience or a military, police or security background is an advantage. You have a strong understanding of flight operations, safety procedures and airspace regulations (EASA or equivalent). You have practical experience with one or more of the following: radio systems, antennas, telemetry, GNSS, radar, video links or long-range communication. You can independently plan, deliver and evaluate customer training in German and/or English. You explain technical topics clearly, give constructive feedback and present confidently to technical and non-technical audiences. You are willing to travel worldwide and work outdoors in demanding conditions, while consistently following safety procedures and local regulations. A valid Class B driving licence is required. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Gynaecological care the way it's supposed to be: Personalised, easy to reach, effective. Women are diagnosed on average four years later than men, across 770 different diseases. They spend 25 % more of their lives in poor health. That is the gender health gap, and science says two things keep it open: too little access to specialists in women's health, and far too little research on women in the first place. femote works on both. Step One: we turn ordinary statutory gynaecological practices into digital care champions. So that the specialists we do have can care for more patients properly, within the resources they are given. Step Two: we turn generalist doctors into specialists by equipping them with clinical diagnostic and decision support built specifically for women's health, trained on data collected by Step One. Where we stand Supported by leaders of the German gynaecological medical associations Backed by industry angels from pharmaceuticals and medical publishing Innovation grant secured from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy Part of the Lausitz Model Region, giving us deep integration into the statutory system and reach to women regardless of their spending power MVP in pilot phase with real practices (Stack: Flutter, Supabase, Postgres. Up for debate once you join) Pre-seed stage, with funding in place to bring you on Tasks We are looking for our first engineer to build femote's product and shape the technical foundation it grows on. As our founding engineer, you will build our first SaaS product, a patient app and a professional interface, under European General Product Safety Regulation guidelines in the first year while we prepare for medical device certification in year two. Every case we capture is structured so it can carry clinical evidence later, which is what makes algorithmic and decision-support features possible at all. You will not build those alone, but you need to direct that work, and the architecture that makes it possible has to be laid now. Requirements We value smartness, humility and the ability to learn and adapt quickly over hard skills on paper. Please apply, even if you don't tick all the boxes. What you have done Experience running a SaaS product from building to shipping to operating in production Strong data modelling and processing , including consent, provenance and pseudonymisation, so captured data can lawfully support clinical evidence and model training later Bonus: experience building algorithmic or AI-enabled features Bonus: experience building in a regulated field (MDR, AI Act, or similar) Bonus: German speaking, though not required How you work You ship fast without lowering the bar. Short iteration cycles and pragmatic solutions, with engineering practices solid enough to stand up to a notified body. You set the pattern, not just the code. Everything the first engineer does becomes the default for everyone after. You write it down, you teach it, and you build with that in mind. You do not think in taboos. You will be reading about discharge, bleeding and pelvic pain at nine in the morning and building interfaces for it. If that is awkward for you, this is not your role. You want to understand why we are doing this in gynaecology. You do not have to arrive as an expert in women's health, and we are happy to offer a steep learning curve. The curiosity has to be yours. You are reflective. You take feedback without putting armour on, and you say when you are stuck rather than when it is already too late. Benefits Meaningful equity as hurdle shares or an instrument with equivalent tax treatment. Genuine ownership of the technical direction Full-time, with flexible working hours Room to grow into the CTO role: owning medical device certification, security and data handling, the engineering team you hire around you, and representing femote's technical direction to regulators, partners and investors. Working closely with our agency partner, you’ll set the direction for budget allocation, testing and optimisation, challenge execution with hands-on platform expertise, and ensure investment is measured against genuine business impact rather than platform-reported results alone. Recommend and govern budget allocation, applying clear scale, hold and stop decisions based on incremental impact, CPA, FTD growth, NGR payback and cohort quality. Lead incrementality testing through geo-tests, audience holdouts and lift studies. Own creative testing, partnering with Creative and Brand to generate repeatable performance insights. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs. Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage). Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation. Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included). Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer. Partnering closely with research, applications, simulation engineering, and cloud/infrastructure teams to translate post-training improvements into measurable downstream impact. Providing technical leadership through mentorship, review, and setting high engineering/research standards. 🙌 You should apply if Essential: You have hands-on experience post-training/fine-tuning large-scale models (language, video, or other foundation models). You have experience with world models, autoregressive generation, and long-horizon generation. You have experience with diffusion/flow models and a solid understanding of 3D vision. You have a strong understanding of model architecture and can contribute meaningfully to architectural/training decisions. You have strong hands-on engineering skills with modern ML stacks (e.g. PyTorch), including debugging and performance/reliability-minded development. You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience (advanced degrees are valued, but depth of applied experience matters more). Desirable: Experience with inference optimisation or deploying large models under latency/compute constraints. Experience improving data/training pipelines and working across infrastructure constraints (distributed training, efficiency, reliability). Proven technical leadership — tech lead ownership, mentoring, or setting direction across an area. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.
