jobs.description: ENGLISH VERSION Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯  Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN ( Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties ), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne , avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin. Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis , reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur ( https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur ) , en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set . Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT . Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée. Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3

jobs.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible

Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team

jobs.title: Critical Operations Technician - Switzerland
jobs.description: The Role As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round. Key Responsibilities Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned. Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards. Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions. Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized. Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures. Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations. Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors). Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups. Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System. Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs. Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools. Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines. Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed. Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent. Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center. In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs. Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy. Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team. Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems. Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients. IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems. Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus). Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction. Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability. All applications will be treated confidentially. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: Unleash AI Innovators, Securely Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it. Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust. Why this role? As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader. What You’ll Do Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond. Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches. Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets. Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit. What You Bring You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role. You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts. You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments. You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling. You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers. It’d Be Awesome If You Also… Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems. Contribute to open-source or developer communities. Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment. Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team. Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo. About Snyk Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk. Equal Employment Opportunity Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world. We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will: Work directly with technical teams at our customers' factories to connect their data and workflows to our software. Apply state of the art AI in challenging real world settings to drive user adoption and prove value to the customer. Collaborate closely with our Deployment Strategists and other Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver value quickly and consistently. Contribute features directly to the product so your customers get the most out of our platform. Proactively keep the product org informed of key pain points and opportunities to make our platform better. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. Please also reach out if you don't check every point below. Must-haves: A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related field. 2+ years of experience solving difficult real world problems with state of the art techniques from software development and data science. Fluency in Python. German at C1 level or above. A consistent track record of outsized impact and going the extra mile. An urge to join a fast-paced, impact-driven team. Bonus: Familiarity with SQL and AI/ML libraries. Familiarity with DevOps and deployment, in the cloud and on premises. Experience in customer-facing roles, especially with enterprise customers. Experience in manufacturing or a related industry. Prior startup experience. WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here at least three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short. Access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here grow fast and take on real responsibility. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in. What you'll do Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features What we're looking for Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc) Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy) A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains You can expect: Competitive salary and stock options Flexible working hours Market-leading parental leave Life at Namespace Labs: We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot. We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism. We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them. At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant. How you'll get there: Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations. Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months. Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product. Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen. It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day. How we work: Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation. Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany. Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code. AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same. What you bring: You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions. You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself. You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration. You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest. You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel. You explain complex things simply , to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management. You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations. You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback. Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English. Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country. Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris). Why us? Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it. Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average. Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany,

jobs.title: Finance Manager (Finance, Data & Automation) (gn) @ Atlantic, Berlin
jobs.description: About Atlantic Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring. As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo. For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown. The role As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor. Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on. What you'll own Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value. Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on. Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions. Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings. Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks. Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management . The mission Fast-forward - here's what you've built: Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it. About you You'll feel at home here if you: Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team.  Know your accounting inside out , and enjoy putting it to work on a fund Think AI-first. Claude is already part of your workday, and anything you do twice, you want to automate Love turning data into insight , not just reconciling it Own your numbers. You work independently, follow through, and double-check because you care Roll up your sleeves. You're as happy running payments today as building the automation that runs them tomorrow Are curious about startups , deep tech and the founders building them Speak fluent German and English Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations. jobs.description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our core Panel Science team. Our team is dedicated to building an uncompromising, mathematically rigorous single source of truth for enterprise consumer analytics. In this role, you will work across a highly sophisticated data engine that bridges foundational statistical modeling, complex data infrastructure, and advanced analytical product architecture. Whether your deep expertise lies in refining core statistical baselines, optimizing heavy computational models, or architecting scalable logic libraries, you will have a massive impact on how enterprise-level consumer insights are delivered. This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. We expect East Coast work hours. As Our Corporate Data Scientist, You Will: Statistical Modeling & Distribution Optimization: Design, validate, and deploy robust, scalable optimization frameworks and distribution models to ensure complete mathematical integrity across downstream metrics. Methodology & Panel Foundations: Explore and execute complex methodologies, evaluate methodological trade-offs, and implement advanced statistical procedures. Analytical Logic & Governance: Partner cross-functionally to transition ad hoc code into standardized, version-controlled templates and logical libraries. You will ensure analytics are structured cleanly to power diverse product surfaces, ranging from interactive dashboards to LLM-driven applications. Infrastructure & Performance Optimization: Partner closely with Data Engineering to optimize code performance and scale analytical workflows. You will help transition complex statistical calculations from standard database queries into efficient, production-grade cloud compute architectures. Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights. The world's top investment funds and Fortune 500 companies depend on our data to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture - recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years - emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It's Like to Work Here: Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end - from methodology to client delivery - and present directly to the investors who depend on it. You won't spend months waiting for "meaningful work." Growth is driven by impact , not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here. AI is a core working tool, not a side project. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done - using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited about that, you'll thrive here. About the Role: YipitData's Central Data team sits at the foundation of everything we deliver. We build the standardized data products, methodologies, and systems that power every downstream business — from our investment research and corporate products to our data feeds. Historically, many teams solved similar data problems independently. Central Data exists to identify those common patterns and build shared solutions that improve quality, consistency, and speed across the company. As a Central Data Lead, you'll own one of these foundational data domains end-to-end. This is a highly analytical product ownership role that combines deep data expertise, systems thinking, technical leadership, and cross-functional execution. Rather than solving one-off analytical problems, you'll design the reusable systems and methodologies that enable dozens of downstream teams to move faster with greater confidence. Each domain is jointly led by a three-person leadership team: Data Lead : owns methodology, data quality, and analytical strategy Technical Product Manager : owns prioritization, roadmap, and business alignment Data Engineering Manager : owns engineering execution, platform architecture, and technical delivery Together, you'll define how your domain evolves while partnering closely with data evaluation, engineering, downstream product teams, and external data partners. We're hiring Data Leads for these two teams: Consumer Receipts : own the systems that process, classify, and validate transaction-level consumer receipt data across millions of purchases. B2B Spend : own the systems that transform complex mid-market and enterprise purchase and invoice data from multiple providers into standardized, production-ready datasets. Your success won't be measured by how many analyses you complete. It will be measured by how effectively you've built systems that make hundreds of future analyses faster, more consistent, and more reliable. What You'll Do: Own the lifecycle of your data domain : from defining how raw partner data should be processed, validated, tagged, and modeled to ensuring downstream teams can confidently build products on top of it. Develop deep expertise in your domain and the mental models needed to identify issues before they impact customers. Build systems that improve data quality : Design validation frameworks, monitoring, and QA systems that proactively detect issues. Reason deeply about representativeness, bias, and systematic risks - not simply whether individual records look correct. jobs.title: Data Scientist, AI/ML
jobs.description: Data Scientist, AI/ML Job Description: Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks, any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix reliability risks before they become incidents. Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable. About the Role of the Data Scientist, AI/ML As a Data Scientist, AI/ML at Gremlin, you will have the opportunity to improve the reliability of the internet at large by turning millions of chaos engineering experiments into automated failure analysis and remediation. jobs.description: This job description was written by a person About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. About the Role Our GTM org has a lot of questions. Most of the questions we care about can’t be answered by spinning up a cute dashboard. Is branded search creating new customers or capturing demand that already existed? Did the homepage redesign improve conversion, or did our traffic mix change? If we’ve got some wild ideas for our next bet, where should the money go? These kinds of big-picture questions require someone who can interrogate the metric, trace it through the warehouse, understand the business context, and turn it into action. This person will be our first Staff GTM Analyst. You’ll work alongside GTM leadership to make consequential decisions while still staying hands-on in the nitty gritty of all the data. The best part: the way we answer these questions is changing. Effective SQL is just a few tokens away, dashboards can be Claude-ed in minutes, and teammates increasingly expect to find their own answers. You’ll build the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that make self-service possible, even trustworthy, then determine where an analyst’s expertise is indispensable. You are An experienced analyst. You have roughly 8 years of hands-on, highly technical analytics experience. Most importantly: you’re backed by the pattern recognition that comes with having seen all sorts of hairy problems. You’re at the point in your career where you can take an ambiguous business question, dive head-first into the data, turn your findings into a decision, and bring everyone else along with you. A bridge between the technical and the business. You can build a model in dbt, work directly in Snowflake, and translate it into something actionable. You’ll partner closely with our Lead Analytics Engineer but you need to be willing and able to dive in and self-serve. Fluent in the quirks of GTM data. Attribution, channel definitions, UTMs, bots and broken tracking are known quantities. You don’t need to have been a dedicated GTM Analyst, but you should certainly know your way around this part of the business. Pushing the boundary of what AI means for analytics. AI is writing your first-draft SQL, analysis, and reporting and you’ve shifted that energy to bringing analysis into the future: building the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that let the team self-serve trustworthy answers. A trusted cross-functional leader. Teammates across functions and levels listen to you. You immerse yourself in the context of their needs and bridge gaps in understanding. Fiercely independent and accountable. You welcome a vague ask with aplomb. You’ll scope the problem, find the dependencies, bring in the right people, and drive the work through the analysis, recommendation…all the way to a fix. More concerned with impact than output. A polished dashboard is useful only when it changes what we do. You prioritize the questions that can materially improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue. You will Make our GTM data trustworthy. You’ll define metrics, model the funnel from first touch through paid conversion, and reconcile discrepancies across Snowflake, Segment, Amplitude, GA4, and our ad platforms. Explain what we’re seeing. Why are trials up while paid conversion isn’t? Why are Snowflake and Amplitude disagreeing? Which channel is driving volume but producing low-quality customers? jobs.title: Senior Pricing Data Scientist
jobs.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role This is a unique role that sits at the intersection of economics, analytics, product, and strategy. You’ll combine rigorous quantitative analysis with customer research and commercial thinking to shape how Fivetran prices, packages, and monetizes its products. What You’ll Do Analyze product usage, deal, financial, and billing data to model pricing, packaging, and monetization scenarios. Design frameworks to assess willingness to pay, customer value, and price realization across customer segments and product lines. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. A backup system for power and internet. A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day. Compensation: Base pay 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue. jobs.title: Arquitecto Empresarial
jobs.description: No solo buscamos talento, buscamos mentes curiosas que disfruten aprender y transformar el futuro. Somos tech, somos exigentes y sí, vamos rápido. Pero nadie compite solo. Trabajamos en equipo y si buscas retos que te saquen de la zona cómoda (porque ahí no crece nadie), estás en el lugar correcto. Aquí aprenderás con expertos, participarás en proyectos de alto impacto y estarás siempre un paso adelante en tecnología. 1. Objetivo del Puesto Liderar la dirección estratégica de la arquitectura corporativa, alineando los objetivos de negocio con un ecosistema tecnológico escalable, moderno y sostenible. Esta posición requiere una visión sistémica, criterio pragmático y alta capacidad de influencia ejecutiva para guiar la toma de decisiones tecnológicas, racionalizar el portafolio de aplicaciones y consolidar el marco de gobierno que habilite la transformación digital de la organización. 2. Responsabilidades Principales Estrategia y Hojas de Ruta: Definir, mantener y evolucionar los modelos de estado actual ( As-Is ) y estado objetivo ( To-Be ) a través de los dominios de Negocio, Datos, Aplicaciones y Tecnología. Gobierno de Arquitectura: Presidir y estructurar el Comité de Revisión Tecnológica y Arquitectura, definiendo estándares, patrones de referencia y políticas corporativas para los equipos de Arquitectura de Solución. Gestión del Portafolio de Aplicaciones (APM): Ejecutar análisis de racionalización para mitigar la deuda técnica, identificar redundancias y priorizar iniciativas de modernización o desincorporación ( decommission ). Supervisión y Mentoría Técnica: Guiar el diseño de soluciones de alta complejidad, asegurando el cumplimiento de los lineamientos corporativos y orientando a los equipos de entrega ( Delivery ). Evaluación Financiera y de Riesgo: Analizar alternativas de inversión técnica y trade-offs considerando el Costo Total de Propiedad (TCO), el valor aportado al negocio y la gestión de riesgos estratégicos. Innovación e Inteligencia Tecnológica: Evaluar la viabilidad técnica y funcional de nuevas tecnologías y plataformas, garantizando su interoperabilidad con las capacidades empresariales existentes. Alineación y Narrativa Ejecutiva: Traducir escenarios y conceptos tecnológicos complejos en narrativas de impacto de negocio para facilitar la toma de decisiones ante Comités y líderes C-Level . 3. Requisitos del Perfil Requisitos No Negociables Experiencia: +10 años en el sector tecnológico, con un mínimo de 5 años desempeñando roles directos de Arquitectura Empresarial o liderazgo arquitectónico transversal. Gobierno y Marcos Estratégicos: Dominio en el establecimiento de comités de arquitectura, gestión de excepciones y marcos de cumplimiento. Modelado de Arquitectura: Experiencia práctica en TOGAF (ADM) y BIZBOK (mapeo de capacidades de negocio). Dominio en modelado ArchiMate (capas de Estrategia, Motivación, Negocio, Aplicación y Tecnología). Herramientas EAM: Manejo de plataformas de Enterprise Architecture Management como LeanIX, Bizzdesign, ServiceNow o Archi. Especialización Técnica: Gestión y racionalización de portafolios de aplicaciones (APM). Patrones de integración moderna (APIs y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos). Estrategias Cloud, modelos de costo FinOps, Zero Trust Security y Gobierno de Datos. Gestión de Stakeholders: Trayectoria comprobable diseñando roadmaps tecnológicos alineados con planes estratégicos de negocio e interactuando directamente con ejecutivos C-Level . Requisitos Deseables Certificación oficial en TOGAF (v9 o v10) o ArchiMate Practitioner . Certificación en SAFe (específicamente Lean Portfolio Management - LPM). Experiencia en industrias de Consumo Masivo (CPG), Retail o Manufactura. Experiencia previa en proyectos de modernización de plataformas legadas (entornos SAP u homólogos). 4. Formación y Competencias Key Formación Académica: Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines. Habilidades y Competencias Críticas: Pensamiento Sisté
